MORE:
Sobhagya Mercantile Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 13/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve 1. the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results along with Limited Review Report thereon for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026
2. an increase in Authorized Share Capital of the Company and consequent alteration in capital clause of the MOA 
3. recommend and approve issue of Bonus Shares to the existing Equity Shareholders of the Company
